top_signals.title: UPS Raises Sales Outlook Ahead of Holiday Season
top_signals.summary:
United Parcel Service raises its sales outlook saying it expects a strong holiday shipping season. The courier raised prices, but demand was still high for the quarter. Earnings and revenue in the third quarter both beat Wall Street estimates. Bloomberg's Matt Griffin reports. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: ¿Machado acelerará la transición democrática en Venezuela?
top_signals.summary: María Corina Machado regresó a Venezuela tras meses en el extranjero. Su llegada pone a prueba la apertura política de Delcy Rodríguez y podría complicar la estrategia de Trump para la transición. (Source: Bloomberg)
